# Differential matrix for the addressable RNG layer (lib/rng.c), the
# master-seed bridge (load_seed/rng_master_seed in lib/rnd.c) and the named
# streams in olympia/*.c, at G3 66b03fb09b541560268e66b553179d06ea30de80.
#
# tools/rng-compat/run.sh feeds this file to a C driver built from the pinned
# sources and records its output in c-output.txt; TestMatchesC feeds it to the
# Go port and requires the same output. The whole file runs in one process,
# so state carries from line to line, as it does in the engine.
#
# One operation per line; '#' starts a comment. Integers are C longs read with
# strtol(s, NULL, 0) and cast to int; tags are read with strtoul.
#
#   master HEX            write the bytes HEX to ./randseed and load_seed() it;
#                         prints rng_master_seed()
#   loadmissing           load_seed() a file that does not exist
#   rnd LOW HIGH          legacy rnd() on the global digest
#   md5int A B C D        md5_int()
#   clock TURN DAY        set sysclock.turn and sysclock.day (shorts)
#   root                  cur = rng_seed(master)
#   of KEY TAG            cur = rng_stream_of(&cur, KEY, TAG)
#   draw LOW HIGH         rng_draw(&cur, LOW, HIGH)
#   keyed K1 K2 TAG L H   rng_keyed(&cur, K1, K2, TAG, L, H)
#   shuffle N             ilist_shuffle_rng() of 100..100+N-1 on &cur
#   call NAME ARGS...     a named-stream helper; list helpers take a length N

# --- Before any seed or seeding: every stream is all zero. A helper that does
# not seed its stream draws from zeros; a turn-guarded stream whose guard
# already matches (turn -1) is never seeded.
clock -1 0
call econ_pick 1 2 1 100
call npc_qty 3 4 0 1000
call crnd 1 6
call prnd 1 6
call qrnd 1 20
call cseq_rnd 1 10
call fseq_rnd 1 10
call hseq_rnd 1 10
call wseq_rnd 1 10
call magc_scry 501 17
call up_loyal 501 0 1 100
call soc_gift 501 502
call ent_build 1234
call mint_city
master 0123
call mint_city
call wgen_prom 1234

# --- The rng_check.c master, {0x01234567, 0x89abcdef, 0xfedcba98, 0x76543210}.
master 67452301efcdab8998badcfe10325476
root
keyed 501 17 0x68697420 1 100
keyed 501 17 0x68697420 1 100
of 501 0x636f6d62
keyed 1 0 0x68697420 1 20
keyed 1 0 0x646d6720 1 6
keyed 1 0 0x6d726c20 1 10
root
of 0 0x636f6d62
root
of 0 0x6d726b74
root
of 7 0x636f6d62
draw 1 1000000
draw 1 1000000
draw 1 1000000

# --- The mapgen fixture seed. Keys and tags at the int and uint32 edges.
master 736c6172746962617274666173743f0a
root

of -2147483648 0x64617920
of 4294967295 1
keyed 0 0 0 0 0
keyed -1 -1 0xffffffff 1 10
keyed 2147483647 -2147483648 0x80000000 -16 -3
keyed 123 456 0x6b657920 0 2147483647
keyed 123 456 0x6b657920 -2147483648 -2147483648
keyed 123 456 0x6b657920 2147483647 2147483647
keyed 123 456 0x6b657920 -5 5
keyed 123 456 0x6b657920 0 4
keyed 123 456 0x6b657920 1000 9999

# Sequential draws: ranges that reject often, empty ranges, negative ranges.
root
of 1 0x73657120
draw 1 10
draw 0 1
draw 111 333
draw 56760 58759
draw 59000 78999
draw 5 5
draw -16 -3
draw 0 2147483647
draw 7 7
draw 0 4
draw 0 4
draw 0 4
draw 0 4
draw 1 3
draw 1 3
draw 1 3
draw -1 2147483646
draw 1000 9999

# Shuffles: lists of 0 and 1 draw nothing.
root
of 2 0x73687566
shuffle 0
shuffle 1
shuffle 2
shuffle 3
shuffle 10
shuffle 52

# --- load_seed: the master seed is the state as loaded, not as advanced by
# rnd(). A short file overwrites only the start of the state. A missing file
# makes the current (advanced) state the master. An empty file changes
# nothing but recaptures it.
master 736c6172746962617274666173743f0a
rnd 1 10
rnd 0 2147483647
rnd -16 -3
root
master 0102
root
rnd 1 100
loadmissing
root
master
rnd 1 100
master
root
md5int 0 0 0 0
md5int 1 2 3 4
md5int -1 -1 -1 -1
md5int 2147483647 -2147483648 12345 -98765
md5int 5001 7023 52 3141592

# --- A new master in the same turn. Streams that reseed on every begin_*()
# pick it up; the turn-guarded streams keep the stream they seeded earlier
# this turn (and the weather and mint counters carry on).
master 0f1e2d3c4b5a69788796a5b4c3d2e1f0
call magc_scry 5001 17
call up_loyal 5001 0 1 100

call ent_build 10234
call expl_gate 5001 10234
call begin_economy 10234
call econ_pick 51 10234 0 3

# --- The next turn reseeds everything, now from the new master.
clock 2 1
call magc_scry 5001 17
call up_loyal 5001 0 1 100
call cal_day 0 1 30
call mint_alloc 1000 9999
call mint_city
call wthr_shuffle 12

call expl_gate 5001 10234
call soc_gift 5001 5002
call skil_study 5001 600
call faer_hunt_qty 0
call hads_nasty 0 0 1 100

# --- Back to an earlier turn: the guard only compares with the last turn
# seen, so turn 1 reseeds again.
clock 1 1
call magc_scry 5001 17
call mint_alloc 1000 9999

# --- sysclock fields are shorts: 40000 is stored as -25536, and 65537 as 1.
clock 40000 70000
call magc_scry 5001 17
call up_heal 5001 0 1 100
call expl_gate 5001 10234
call begin_battle 10234 5001 5002
call crnd 1 100
clock 65537 1
call magc_scry 5001 17
call begin_battle 10234 5001 5002
call crnd 1 100
